extracted.name: Decorator Frosting
extracted.description: This frosting recipe for icing decorations is perfect for sugar cookies.
instruction_lines: Cream together butter, confectioners' sugar, and milk in a bowl until light and fluffy, 3 to 4 minutes. Beat in vanilla and food coloring. Spread on or between cookies.
